name: Room, slow glide
summary: A slow sideways glide through the room in your photo.
outcome: A slow sideways glide through the room shown in your photo, with soft daylight and light moving gently on the walls.
photoGuidance: A photo of one room, taken from a corner or doorway.
Hold the camera level so walls stay straight.
limitations: The video stays within what your photo shows. It can't show rooms, angles or parts of the property that aren't in the photo.
Text and logos in your photo may change in the video. Check the result before you post it.

inputs.label: The room
inputs.help: For example, 'living room with a grey sofa'.
inputs.example: Living room with a grey sofa

inputs.label: Details to keep as they are
inputs.help: Optional. For example, the colour of your cups or the shape of a sign.

inputs.label: Anything to leave out
inputs.help: Optional. For example, no smoke or no people.

prompt.preserve: Keep everything in the photo recognisable: the same objects, shapes, colours and proportions. Keep any printed text, labels and logos as they are.
prompt.avoid: Do not add people, hands, text, captions, logos or new objects. No sudden cuts, no camera shake, no warping or melting of surfaces.
prompt.subject: The photo shows {subject}.
prompt.composition: Keep the room's layout and straight lines exactly as in the photo.
prompt.environment: Only the room in the photo is shown. Nothing is added beyond its walls.
prompt.camera: The camera glides slowly and smoothly to one side.
prompt.subjectMotion: Curtains move very slightly. The furniture stays still.
prompt.lighting: Soft daylight with light moving gently on the walls.
